integrity_statement: The definitions and the family with one adjoined top are credited to earlier work. The mathematical contribution asserted here is the complete family of materializers, its inclusion order, rank polynomial, exact satisfiability formula for arbitrary added chain length, and the resulting two-scale asymptotics. Computer enumeration supplies independent finite tests, not a proof for all parameters.
scientific_limitations: All results concern finite Boolean algebras with a positive-length chain adjoined above their former greatest element. The theorem does not claim materializer-order reconstruction for arbitrary Heyting algebras. Earlier equivalent formulations in specialized literature cannot be excluded; no independent validation has been conducted.
title: Materializer order reconstruction and two-scale material-implication loss in Boolean--chain Heyting algebras
